paite: Mosi in biakbuk alam khit a, thau anilh khit a, ahihsiangthou khit a, van tengteng leh maitam leh tui-um belsuan tengteng thaunilh a, ahihsiangthou ni in hichi ahi a,
heading: Heutute Thillatte
english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

paite: Israel intekpen, a-inkuan ua intekpente'n thillat alan ua, huaite anam ua intekpente, asimte uh tung a omte ahi uh.
english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

paite: Athillatte uh kangtalai tung nei guk leh bawngtal sawm-le-nih, intekpen nih in kangtalai khat zel, khat in bawngtal khat zel TOUPA ma ah ahon paipih ua, biakbuk ah ahong lan uhi.
english: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Biakbuk nasepna ding in aphatuam kha ding, na la chiat un; Levite, anasep uh dungzui zel in na pe chiat ding hi," achi hi.
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in kangtalaite leh bawngtalte ala a, Levite khut ah apia hi.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

paite: Kangtalai nih leh bawngtal li Gershon tapate anasep uh dungzui zel in apia hi.
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

paite: Kangtalai li leh bawngtal giat, siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar, Merari tapate anasep uh dungzui in apia hi.
english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Kohath tapate bel mun siangthou a nasep amau a tuam hi a, anasep uh azawnthoh ahih ziak in ape kei hi.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

paite: Intekpente'n thaunilh ni in maitam latna dia athillatte uh maitam bul ah alan uhi.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Intekpen chih in maitam latna dia athillat, athillat uh amau tan hi zel ding in alan ding uhi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

paite: Ni khat ni a thillat lan ding mi Judah chi Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding in thau helsa tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoihna thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi a, hiaite Amminadab tapa Nashon thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Ni nih ni in Issakar intekpente'n Zuar tapa Nethaneel in alan hi.
english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

paite: Athillat ding in dangkasik kuang khat agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoihna thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga alan hi. Hiaite Zuar tapa Nethaneel thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Ani thum ni in Zebulun tate intekpen Helon tapa Eliab in alan hi.
english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Ani li ni in Reuben tate intekpen Shedeur tapa Elizur in alan hi.
english: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat dia thau hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Ani nga ni in Simeon tate intekpen Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel in alan hi.
english: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum; mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding in thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Ani guk ni in Gad tate intekpen Deuel tapa Eliasaph in alan hi.
english: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,

paite: Athillat dang-kasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

paite: Ani sagih ni in Ephraim tate intekpen Ammihud tapa Elishama in alan hi.
english: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat; halmang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

paite: Ani giat ni in Manasseh tate intekpen Pedazur tapa Gamaliel in alan hi.
english: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel, tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Pedazur tapa Gamaliel thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Ani kua ni in Benjamin tate intekpen Gideoni tapa Abidan in alan hi.
english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Gideoni tapa Abidan thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Ani sawm ni in Dan tate intekpen Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer in alan hi.
english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Ani sawm-le-khat ni in Asher tate intekpen Okran tapa Pagiel in alan hi.
english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel sawm-thum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat upa ngate Okran tapa Pagiel thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Ani sawm-le-nih ni in Naphtali tate intekpen Enan tapa Ahira in alan hi.
english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Enan tapa Ahira thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Maitam thau nilh ni a Israel intekpente thillatte dangkasik kuang sawm-le-nih, dangkasik belhbu sawm-le-nih leh dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih ahi.
english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

paite: Dangkasik kuang shekel za-le-sawmthum toh kikim a gik chiat ahi a, belhbu sawmsagih chiat ahi. Dangkasik tui-um belsuan tengteng mun siangthou a shekel sangnih-le-zali toh kikim a gik ahi.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

paite: Gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih mun siangthou a shekel sawm toh kikim a gik chiat ahi. Dangka-eng keu tengteng shekel za-le-sawmnih toh kikim a gik ahi.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

paite: Haltum thillat ding bawngtal tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi a, belamtal sawm-le-nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-nih; atangbuang thillatte uh toh, Khelh thoihna ding keltal sawm-le-nih.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

paite: Lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal sawmnih-le-li ahi a, belamtal bel sawmguk, keltal sawmguk, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawmguk ahi. Hiai thau nilh khit a maitam latna dia thilpiakte ahi uh.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

paite: Huchi in biakbuk a amah be dia Mosi alut in thukhun bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah tunglam a cherub nihte kikal a pan amah ahoupihna aw aza hi.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
